generator_metadata.summary: 0-bg grid (h, w~12-16) with: (a) ONE HORIZONTAL SEED SEQUENCE at some center-ish row cr — 3-4 consecutive cells (starting at random col h_start) painted in distinct colors from a 4-color palette (palette colors used in order); (b) ONE VERTICAL SEED SEQUENCE at some center-ish col cc — 3-4 consecutive cells (starting at random row v_start) painted in the same palette order. Both sequences lie on the SAME center row/col axes. Rule: identify the row with the most non-bg cells (the H-axis center row) and the col with the most (the V-axis center col). For each axis, CYCLE the seed sequence across the ENTIRE row/col — extending the palette pattern (in order) to all cells of that row/col on both sides of the seeds. Net: a small seed sequence on each axis becomes a full periodic stripe spanning the row and column.

# Review handoff

Assignment: `review-17f71dee11dab1cf`; reviewer work is complete for both assigned targets.
Status: both native families are `ready`; owner acceptance and training admission remain pending by design.
`882c01c42710` is now generator version `2.2.0`; its occupied-crossing rejection and inert controls were repaired.
`7195f447bb20` is now generator version `2.1.0`; its lessons now expose the predecessor/successor guard and reject the unguarded shortcut.
Canonical authority rows were not edited; both default Racket programs reproduce the selected canonical program byte-for-byte.
Focused verification: 15 tests passed (`7 + 8`) in `checks/final-focused-tests.log`.
Protected authoring preflight: four episodes and 32 Racket evaluations per target; both receipts report `passed`.
Public projection: 16 saved views per target passed structure checks; four first turns each passed 24 invariance checks and four positive controls.
Causal evidence was independently replayed for both alternatives; changing/skipping A changes the final output through the named intermediate.
No catalog approval flag was changed, and no training admission is claimed.

## `882c01c42710`

The base generator previously rejected a legal occupied intersection and did not reliably consume its declared dimensions and sequence lengths. The repaired generator accepts canonical-like crossings, uses `grid_h`, `grid_w`, `n_h`, `n_v`, palette and anchor controls, and remains deterministic.

The native family has two episode-fixed modes:

- `canonical`: independently tiles the original horizontal and vertical periods, preserving the exact selected program.
- `phase_locked`: step A tiles the horizontal row; its intersection color is the intermediate; step B rotates the vertical seed so that color lands at the intersection before tiling the column.

The fourth query is 30×30 and paints the full 59-cell cross. The replayed `wrong_intermediate` witness is in `checks/882c01c42710/causal/`; authoring qualification is in `checks/882c01c42710/qualification/`.

## `7195f447bb20`

The prior generator emitted only easy isolated `4,0,4` diagonals, so the wrong rule “fill every diagonal midpoint” fit all generated lessons. The repair adds an exact pure-Python mirror, active shape/count controls, named competitors, deterministic construction, and at least one guarded non-fill plus multiple eligible fills i

sequential_dependency.intermediate: The color written by step A at the horizontal-row/vertical-column intersection.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Tile the horizontal seed sequence across its selected row.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Find that intermediate color in the vertical seed, rotate the vertical phase so it aligns at the intersection, and tile the selected column.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Step B cannot choose the vertical rotation until step A has produced the intersection color; replacing that value with another seed color changes the final vertical stripe.
